description:
A private countryside residence just 1km from Foxford town. Approached via a picturesque, tree-lined driveway. This home immediately sets a tone of privacy and seclusion. The gently winding entrance leads you away from the road and into an elevated countryside setting, where the property reveals itself in a peaceful and mature natural environment.

This is an exceptional five-bedroom residence set on approximately 1.8 acres in a peaceful countryside setting. Extending to 302sqm the property offers generous, well-designed accommodation across three levels, including multiple reception areas, five bedrooms (with four en-suite), two home offices and a dedicated gym.

Finished to a high standard throughout, the home benefits from a BER B3 rating, EV charging point, and a range of modern upgrades, while the elevated position enjoys superb natural light and scenic views towards Nephin Mountain.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious, energy-efficient family home combining contemporary comfort with the tranquillity of country living, all within easy reach of local amenities, schools and transport links.
